component.name: Universal Android Debloater Next Generation
component.summary: Manage unwanted apps on non-rooted Android devices

description.p: Universal Android Debloater Next Generation uses Android Debug Bridge (ADB) to manage preinstalled apps on a connected Android device. Browse installed packages, read descriptions and recommendations, and disable, uninstall, or restore apps without rooting the device.

screenshot.caption: Browse apps on a connected Android device
